channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): The record said an October 24, 2017 hearing had been…
item.description: The record said an October 24, 2017 hearing had been called and that no later Port or Board document was found. That hearing date was in the resolution as introduced; the Board changed it and adopted the resolution on July 24, 2018, calling the hearing for September 11, 2018. The Board then created the Hoedown Yard financing district by Ordinance 248-18, approved November 2, 2018, after a landowner election on October 16, 2018. Whether the City has bought the yard from PG&E is still not answered by any source read. Source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, Resolution 234-18, File 170880, July 24, 2018 (https://sanfrancisco.legistar1.com/sanfrancisco/attachments/124711.pdf); City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, Ordinance 248-18, File 180772, Nov 2, 2018 (https://sanfrancisco.legistar1.com/sanfrancisco/attachments/127800.pdf); City and County of San Francisco, Department of Elections, Canvass and Statement of Result of Election, Oct 16, 2018 (https://sanfrancisco.legistar1.com/sanfrancisco/attachments/126917.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Hoedown Yard 3 now says 'planned' reflects only the…
item.description: Hoedown Yard 3 now says 'planned' reflects only the adopted Design for Development; the land is owned by PG&E, the City holds an option to buy it, and no source read reports a project, developer or start date. Source: Port Item 9B, 2017-09-22 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Pier 70 Design for Development (sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): The note on the Port's 2026 phasing plan now says the…
item.description: The note on the Port's 2026 phasing plan now says the Hoedown Yard parcels sit outside every phase outline while Parcel K South is in Phase 2B. The 2017 Port staff report and the Sep 26, 2017 minutes are now cited for the yard being separate from the 28-Acre Project and for the approvals being adopted. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port Item 11A staff report, 2017-08-03 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Pier%2070%20Final.pdf); Port Commission minutes, 2017-09-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/2994/download?inline).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): The Hoedown Yard is no longer called 'former' or 'that…
item.description: The Hoedown Yard is no longer called 'former' or 'that once occupied this area': the D4D describes it as PG&E-owned land that HDY3 is part of, outside Brookfield's 28-acre site, and the map notes give the Assessor lots the D4D names and drop an uncited brochure. Resolution 17-45 is described as zoning the whole Special Use District, the Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. Source credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or name OEWD as publisher. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 SUD Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.description: The 2017 projection of $736,000 in annual Community Facilities District special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard, previously repeated on this record, is now listed once in the shared site-wide cost list for Pier 70, and this record points to it. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 9B: Pier 70 Mixed-Use Project approvals, 2017-09-22, p.16 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) says the Hoedown Yard IRFD tax increment, one of three gap-funding sources for the affordable sites, is 'currently unavailable as market-rate development has yet to occur' (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Mayor approves Ordinance No. 248-18 (File… (Nov 2, 2018)
item.description: Mayor approves Ordinance No. 248-18 (File 180772), creating Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard, Pier 70); the Board of Supervisors had finally passed it on October 23, 2018 (Nov 2, 2018). Source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-11-02.
item.source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-11-02

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Board of Supervisors passes the… (Oct 16, 2018)
item.description: Board of Supervisors passes the ordinance creating the district on first reading (its September 11, 2018 consideration had been continued), and the district's three qualified landowners cast all three votes in favor on each of four ballot measures, including formation, the financing plan and bonds of up to $91.9 million (2017 dollars) (Oct 16, 2018). Source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-11-02; City and County of San Francisco, Department of Elections, 2018-10-16.
item.source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-11-02; City and County of San Francisco, Department of Elections, 2018-10-16

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Board of Supervisors adopts Resolution… (Jul 24, 2018)
item.description: Board of Supervisors adopts Resolution No. 234-18 (File 170880), the resolution of intention to establish Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard, Pier 70), calling its formation hearing for September 11, 2018; the resolution as introduced on July 25, 2017 had named October 24, 2017, a date the amendments of November 9 and December 5, 2017 and July 12, 2018 replaced before adoption, so the adopted resolution did not call a hearing for that date (Jul 24, 2018). Source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-07-24; Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
item.source: City and County of San Francisco, Board of Supervisors, 2018-07-24; Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port Commission consents to zoning the… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission consents to zoning the Hoedown Yard (Assessor's Blocks 4120/002 and 4711/008A per the memo) into the Pier 70 Special Use District (Resolution 17-45) and recommends the IRFD (17-49) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2017-09-26.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2017-09-26

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents to zoning amendments establishing the Pier 70 Special Use District over the 28-Acre Site, the 20th & Illinois Street Parcel and the PG&E-owned Hoedown Yard, and approves the Design for Development, bringing the Hoedown Yard into the SUD land-use and height framework as a future development parcel; the Hoedown Yard is not part of FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2017-09-26.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2017-09-26
